title: bus.channel.stale v1
description: Emitted by the staleness-monitor adapter (adapters/staleness/) when a channel's silence since its last event exceeds a data-derived threshold. Watches the watchers: makes silent emitter death (a producer that stops publishing without crashing) visible instead of discoverable only by manual investigation weeks/months later.

channel.description: The nbus:<channel> stream name that went stale (event type, e.g. deer-flow.bead.enriched.v1)

last_event_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the last observed entry on this stream

expected_gap_seconds.description: The staleness threshold this run computed: max(p95_historical_gap_seconds * multiplier, floor_seconds)

observed_gap_seconds.description: Actual elapsed seconds since last_event_at at the time this alert was computed

baseline_sample_size.description: Number of historical inter-event gaps sampled to compute the baseline (channels with <5 lifetime events are 'sparse' and never alerted on, so this is always >=5 for an actual alert)

p95_gap_seconds.description: The p95 historical inter-event gap this run measured, before multiplier/floor were applied

multiplier.description: Config multiplier applied to p95_gap_seconds to derive expected_gap_seconds

floor_seconds.description: Config floor applied via max() to derive expected_gap_seconds
